title: Publication-Ready Figures for Cancer Bioinformatics
text: Publication-ready figures cancer bioinformatics. gfplot provides plotting helpers recur molecular-subtype, biomarker, risk-score papers: Kaplan-Meier curves hazard ratios, ROC time-dependent ROC curves, multiple-ROC comparisons, risk-score distributions, PCA UMAP projections, boxplots, correlation plots, lasso coefficient paths, enrichment plots, immune-infiltration radar charts.

title: gfplot 0.2.0
text: Modernisation 0.1.0 package. Every exported function keeps name arguments, existing scripts continue run unchanged.

title: gfplot 0.2.0
text: plot_barplot() callable: took arguments referenced undefined variables. now working grouped bar plot optional significance annotations. plot_cor() computed group-specific colour scales never assigned , groups argument effect plot. plot_KMCurve() used class(x) == "factor", errors R 4.2 later class vector one element. now uses .factor() .logical(). plot_KMCurve() computed hazard ratio survcomp. now uses univariable Cox model survival package, gives hazard ratio confidence interval without Bioconductor dependency. plot_Boxplot() longer relies qplot(), handles non-factor groups, builds every pairwise comparison instead assuming two groups. plot_immune() longer hard-codes positions immune-cell columns, previously broke panels different number cell types. plot_RiskScore() coerces non-factor event vectors reading levels; previously numeric event vector produced empty colour scale. plot_MulROC() uses sprintf() instead stringr::str_pad(), removing undeclared dependency. plot_TimeROC() plot_GO() label axes correctly use current ggplot2 line-width semantics. plot_lasso() uses tidyr::pivot_longer() instead retired reshape::melt() drops unused text-position data frame. plot_ROC() now accepts matrix well data frame scores. 0.1.0 matrix walked element element, raised length error. curve layout unchanged, spurious warning precrec ggplot2 4.0 suppressed. plot_KMCurve() longer passes element_blank() risk-table title, current survminer ggplot2 reject.

title: gfplot 0.2.0
text: survminer, pROC, stringr, ggpubr, survival now declared. 0.1.0 used missing DESCRIPTION, clean installation fail run time. reshape, ggfortify, MASS, survcomp longer needed. Optional back ends (fgsea, ggpubr, ggsignif, glmnet, ggradar, HTSanalyzeR2, survivalROC, umap) declared Suggests checked call time actionable error message, library(gfplot) works without . LICENSE, URL, BugReports fields added.
